traits.strengths: High sense of responsibility, meticulous personality, consideration for others, planned thinking, delicate emotions
traits.weaknesses: Excessive stress, perfectionism, indecision, timidity, and worry
traits.personality: With a calm and cautious personality, he pursues perfection in everything he does. They have an excellent ability to read and consider other people's emotions, and value order and rules.
traits.communication: I tend to speak in a roundabout way rather than express myself directly, and I try not to hurt the other person's feelings. There is a tendency to avoid conflict.
traits.leadership: Demonstrate democratic and considerate leadership. He listens well to the opinions of his members and is excellent at creating a harmonious atmosphere.

relationships.love: They pursue true love and are devoted to the other person. They are romantic and attentive in their love, but can be very jealous.
relationships.friendship: As a loyal friend, I value deep and long-lasting friendships. You worry about your friend's difficulties and help them as if it were your own.
relationships.work: We value teamwork and seek harmony with colleagues. They have a strong sense of responsibility, carry out their duties faithfully, and are good at mediating conflicts.

career.workStyle: We handle work in a planned and systematic manner. We never miss a detail and strive for perfect results.
career.advice: Reduce the stress caused by perfectionism and learn to be satisfied with sometimes even 80% completion.

health.mentalHealth: You are sensitive to stress and prone to anxiety. You need plenty of rest and a stable environment.
health.stressManagement: Maintain a regular lifestyle and relieve stress through hobby activities. Meditation or yoga can help.
health.lifestyle: Focus on eating healthy and getting enough sleep. It is best to avoid excessive drinking or smoking.

A.name: Type A
A.description: Type A, who is meticulous and responsible, values ​​order and harmony, and has a warm heart that is considerate of others.

traits.strengths: Outstanding creativity, strong personality, honest personality, adaptability, passionate
traits.weaknesses: Capriciousness, lack of concentration, disregard for rules, selfishness, mood swings
traits.personality: I have a free-spirited and creative personality and I hate being stuck in a rut. They express their emotions honestly and have a lot of curiosity about new things.
traits.communication: Express yourself directly and honestly. They do not hide their thoughts and tend to reveal their emotions as they are.
traits.leadership: Demonstrates charismatic and creative leadership. Present new ideas and energize the team.

relationships.love: I pursue a passionate and free relationship. They express their feelings honestly to others and do not have a strong desire to be exclusive.
relationships.friendship: He is a fun and active friend. I enjoy being around a variety of people and bring joy to my friends.
relationships.work: I value autonomy and prefer creative work. Being in an environment with lots of rules or restrictions can be stressful.

career.workStyle: I prefer a creative and free work style. We generate new ideas and pursue change.
career.advice: Sometimes, recognize the importance of rules and plans, and develop the habit of performing tasks consistently.

health.mentalHealth: Although they may have frequent mood swings, they are quick to recover from stress. Mental health improves in a free environment.
health.stressManagement: Relieve stress through a variety of activities. Exercise, travel, or new hobbies can help.
health.lifestyle: Maintain a free lifestyle, but don't neglect basic health care.

B.name: Type B
B.description: Type B, who is free and creative, values ​​originality and individuality, and is an attractive personality who is honest about the emotions of the moment.

traits.strengths: Excellent intuition, original thinking, cool judgment, artistic sense, adaptability
traits.weaknesses: Dual personality, temperamental, difficult, cynical, unpredictable
traits.personality: It is a complex and unique personality that shows different appearances depending on the situation. They are rational yet emotional, cold yet warm.
traits.communication: Depending on the situation, I may be direct or I may speak indirectly. Adjust your communication style by understanding the other person and their mood.
traits.leadership: Demonstrate flexible leadership appropriate to the situation. He is a balanced leader who possesses both creativity and rationality.

relationships.love: You attract others with your mysterious charm, but it takes time for them to open your heart. We are looking for someone who truly understands.
relationships.friendship: Prefers to have a few true friends. You enjoy in-depth conversations and choose your friends carefully.
relationships.work: Able to handle work creatively yet logically. We prefer to work independently and value professionalism.

career.workStyle: Balances creativity and logic. This is a work style that combines original ideas and systematic execution.
career.advice: Recognize your dual nature as a strength rather than a weakness, and use diverse perspectives to solve problems.

health.mentalHealth: You may feel stressed due to your complex inner life. You need your own time and space.
health.stressManagement: Relieve stress through art or creative activities. It is important to have enough alone time.
health.lifestyle: Pursue a balanced lifestyle. It is better to pursue calmness rather than overstimulation.

AB.name: Type AB
AB.description: The unique and mysterious type AB is a complex and attractive personality that possesses the characteristics of both type A and type B.

traits.strengths: Strong leadership, drive, sociability, sense of reality, positive mindset
traits.personality: He has an active and outgoing personality and has excellent leadership skills. Live a realistic, practical, and goal-oriented life.
traits.communication: Prefer clear and direct communication. Expresses one's opinions with confidence and has excellent persuasive power.
traits.leadership: A natural leader, he shows strong drive and determination. Excellent ability to lead a team and achieve goals.

relationships.love: I love actively and passionately. I like to lead, and I clearly express my affection for others.
relationships.friendship: They are popular and play a central role among their friends. I have a wide network and take good care of my friends.
relationships.work: Prefers to lead a team and excels in a competitive environment. Take proactive steps to achieve your goals.

career.workStyle: Goal-oriented and results-oriented work style. Achieve results through quick decisions and execution.
career.advice: Sometimes, cultivate caution and patience, and get into the habit of listening to other people's opinions.

health.mentalHealth: Resistant to stress and quick to recover. Maintain your mental health by staying active.
health.stressManagement: Relieve stress through exercise or sports activities. Competitive activities help.
health.lifestyle: Maintain an active lifestyle. Regular exercise and a balanced diet are important.

O.name: Type O
O.description: Type O, who is active and leadership, achieves goals with confidence and drive, and has a sociable and positive personality.
